text: Shahm Holding is a family holding company founded by Muammar Al-Atawi (chairman) with his brothers Nayef Al-Atawi (vice chairman) and Ahmed Al-Atawi (CEO and managing director).
short: Shahm Holding is the Al-Atawi brothers' family holding.

source.name: Shahm Holding: About
source.quote: I had the honor of founding this family holding company alongside my brother, Nayef Alatawi, Vice Chairman of the Board, and my brother, Ahmed Alatawi, CEO and Managing Director.
